full_prompt_en: The image is a square, densely inked fantasy illustration of two travelers standing among enormous twisted roots and weathered carved forms, in muted moss green, stone gray, rust red, and dusty blue. The background is a dark narrow opening between the roots, and its receding shadow makes the two figures stand forward. Along the left edge, pale gray knots and face-like reliefs emerge from a massive trunk or stony surface; their circular hollows and curved ridges are described with many small black lines. A thick root slopes down from the upper left to the lower middle, carrying rough bark marks, mossy patches, and deep grooves. Near the center, a taller dark-haired figure stands with the chest turned slightly right and the gaze lifted toward the upper right. A long rust-red outer garment hangs around a textured blue vest and light shirt, while green trousers and brown boots remain visible below. One dark-gloved hand rests close to a long straight object that reaches from the waist to the ground. Just behind and to the right stands a shorter figure in a green cap, pale shirt, dark outer layer, and gray trousers. This second figure also looks right and holds another long narrow object upright beside the body. On the right, another pale root rises and bends inward, framing the figures against a small patch of brighter upper background. At ground level, overlapping green leaves, small pink flowers, fallen pieces of wood, and a few pale stones spread across the foreground. Fine hatching and contour lines follow the direction of bark, cloth folds, and carved hollows; color lies within them in restrained, uneven washes rather than broad flat fills. The light enters most strongly from the upper right, bringing pale highlights to the nearer root, faces, collars, and low foliage while the central gap stays dark. The two upright figures interrupt the tangled curving environment, providing a clear scale and a calm point of attention within the crowded scene. The overall composition is intricate and adventurous, with warm clothing colors held against cool rooted stone and a strong contrast between open faces and densely marked surroundings.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、墨线密集的奇幻插画：两位旅行者站在巨大的扭曲树根与风化雕刻形体之间，色彩为低调的苔绿、石灰、锈红和灰蓝。背景是树根间狭窄而深暗的开口，逐渐后退的阴影让两个人物凸显在前。沿左边缘，苍灰色的树结和面孔般的浮雕从巨大树干或石质表面中浮出；环状凹洞与弯曲凸脊都由许多细小黑线描绘。一根粗根从左上斜向下方中央，带着粗糙树皮痕迹、苔色斑块与深沟。靠近中央，较高的黑发人物胸部略朝右，视线抬向右上。一件长锈红色外衣围绕着有纹理的蓝色背心与浅色衬衫，下方露出绿裤和棕靴。一只深色手套的手靠近一件从腰部伸到地面的长直器物。他身后偏右站着较矮的人物，戴绿帽、穿浅色上衣、深色外层和灰裤。第二个人也望向右方，并在身旁竖持另一件细长器物。右侧，另一根浅色树根向上升起并向内弯曲，把人物框在上方一小块更亮的背景前。地面上，重叠的绿叶、小粉花、落木碎块和少数浅色石块铺满前景。细密排线和轮廓线顺着树皮、衣褶及雕刻凹洞的方向行走；颜色以克制、不均匀的薄涂留在其间，并非大片平涂。光线主要从右上进入，给近处树根、面孔、衣领和低矮叶丛带来浅色亮部，中央缝隙则保持幽暗。两位直立人物打断纠缠弯曲的环境，为拥挤场景提供清楚的尺度和安静的注视点。整体构图繁复且富于冒险气息，暖色衣装与冷色根石相对，开阔的脸部和密线环绕的环境形成强烈反差。
style_prompt_en: A densely inked illustrative treatment combines sinuous contour drawing, fine directional hatching, and restrained translucent color. Curves interweave on several scales; large pale masses frame smaller dark recesses, while crisp upright silhouettes give the eye a resting point. Moss green, muted blue, weathered gray, and warm rust are applied in broken, uneven areas, leaving black linework visible through each colored plane. Texture follows the form: tight marks deepen hollows and shadowed folds, while sparer lines let raised surfaces catch pale light. Illumination arrives obliquely, setting small warm highlights against broad cool shade rather than smoothing every transition. Foreground details are compact and layered, and a narrow dark interval pulls the composition inward. The resulting style feels tactile, intricate, and storybook-like, with a strong sense of depth made from line density and overlapping contours.
style_prompt_zh: 这种墨线密集的插画处理结合了蜿蜒轮廓、细小定向排线与克制的透明色层。不同尺度的曲线相互穿织；大片浅色形体围住较小的深色凹处，清楚的竖向剪影让视线有停顿点。苔绿、低调蓝、风化灰与暖锈红以破碎且不均匀的色域铺开，使黑色线描在各色平面中仍然可见。纹理顺着形体运行：紧密线条加深凹洞与暗色褶皱，较稀疏的笔线则让凸起表面接住浅光。光斜向进入，以细小暖亮部对照宽阔冷色阴影，而不把每处过渡都磨平。前景细节紧凑叠置，狭窄的深暗间隙把构图引向内部。最终画风可触、繁复而有绘本感，纵深主要由线条密度与轮廓重叠构成。
theme_en: Two travelers with long objects amid immense twisting roots and carved stone forms
theme_zh: 两位旅行者持长形器物站在巨大的盘根与雕刻石形之间
name: Barry Windsor-Smith
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
